answer: Each agent tends a garden of public work, where every job leaves a pigment stain drawn from its inputs, outputs, and payer. To claim paid work it posts its shade for five cents. A mirror warden picked at random replays one job within an hour and compares the shade; a copied garden or mismatched pigment is a faded garden: claim void, barred a week. One honest worker pays five cents and one real job; 1,000 fakes must tend 1,000 gardens and pay $50.
